command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== bundled inputs ship in the gromacs package (zero staging) =="
GRO=/opt/conda/share/gromacs/top/spc216.gro
test -f "$GRO"
test -d /opt/conda/share/gromacs/top/amber99sb-ildn.ff

cat > topol.top <<'EOF'
#include "amber99sb-ildn.ff/forcefield.itp"
#include "amber99sb-ildn.ff/tip3p.itp"
[ system ]
water
[ molecules ]
SOL 216
EOF
cat > md.mdp <<'EOF'
integrator = md
nsteps = 20
dt = 0.002
cutoff-scheme = Verlet
coulombtype = cut-off
rvdw = 0.9
rcoulomb = 0.9
constraints = h-bonds
EOF

echo "== grompp + mdrun: 216 SPC waters, 20 steps =="
gmx_mpi grompp -f md.mdp -c "$GRO" -p topol.top -o t.tpr -maxwarn 5 > grompp.log 2>&1
gmx_mpi mdrun -s t.tpr -deffnm out -ntomp "${GMX_NTOMP:-2}" -nsteps 20 > mdrun.log 2>&1
printf 'Potential\nTotal-Energy\n' | gmx_mpi energy -f out.edr -o e.xvg > energy.log 2>&1

python3 - <<'PY' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import re, sys
fail=[]
def check(label, ok, detail):
    print(f"{label:24s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(label)

energy=open("energy.log").read()
mdrun=open("mdrun.log").read()
natoms=int(open("out.gro").read().splitlines()[1].strip())

# shape, straight from the structure mdrun wrote -- exact
check("atoms_in_system", natoms==648, f"{natoms}  want exactly 648 (216 SPC x 3)")

# potential energy: reproduction of aarch.science's published D3 figure on this pinned
# image. bit-stable across ntomp 1/2/4 (measured), so the band is tight.
pe=re.search(r"^Potential\s+(-?\d+\.?\d*)", energy, re.M)
pe_val=float(pe.group(1)) if pe else 0.0
check("potential_energy", -9629.0 < pe_val < -9626.0,
      f"{pe_val}  want -9629..-9626 (published D3 -9627.9; observed -9627.87)")
check("per_water_energy", -46.0 < pe_val/216.0 < -43.0,
      f"{pe_val/216.0:.3f}  want -46..-43 kJ/mol/water (physical cohesion)")

te=re.search(r"^Total Energy\s+(-?\d+\.?\d*)", energy, re.M)
check("total_energy_readable", te is not None, f"{te.group(1) if te else 'MISSING'}  want a value (exercises .edr reader)")

# completion sentinel: GROMACS prints the Performance: summary only on clean finish
check("mdrun_completed", "Performance:" in mdrun, f"{'yes' if 'Performance:' in mdrun else 'NO'}  want the Performance: summary")

if fail:
    print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
PY
cat smoke-check.txt
test -s out.gro; test -s e.xvg
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
